proposals.evidence: Both sides set acB true on mousedown/touchstart, false on mouseup/touchend/close paths, and guard the rotate handlers with if(!acB)return — the inspect-drag flag.

proposals.evidence: Both sides ease acC toward acD each frame (acC+=(acD-acC)*0.1) and apply it to the inspected model's scale — the current inspect zoom.
proposals.name: inspectZoom

proposals.evidence: On both sides the wheel handler clamps acD to 1.4..2.2 and acC lerps toward it — the target inspect zoom.

proposals.evidence: Both sides show acE created only as {scale:0} and immediately aliased by acF with zero independent uses, so it has no distinct role of its own to name.
On both sides acF is tweened on 'scale' (-0.8 to 0) at inspect open and read as acC+acF.scale when sizing the model — the animated zoom intro-offset state.

proposals.evidence: Both sides store changedTouches[0].identifier into acG on touchstart and match touch.identifier==acG in touchmove — the active inspect touch id.

proposals.evidence: On both sides acH is a Vector2 seeded with the touchstart clientX/Y, then differenced against and updated from the moving touch — the last touch position.

proposals.evidence: On both sides acK is the same {canvas,antialias,alpha} shape passed to new WebGL1Renderer inside the catch fallback; DECL-window-only but role matches on both sides.

proposals.evidence: Both sides define acL to setSize the renderer to window*devicePixelRatio plus domElement CSS size, called after canvas prepend, at init, and on resize — the inspect-renderer resizer.
